Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu

Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(growthcurver)
```
Read in data
```{r,read in raw data}
Dev<-read.csv("Kyn 072023/Kyn1 DevTime2.csv")
```
Compute sums
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
Dev%>%group_by(Treatment,Hours,Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    Sex = Sex,
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Hours=Hours,
    Totalpupae=Totalpupae,
    NTreat = sum(CumulativeSum, na.rm = TRUE))->Dev_Sum
Dev_Sum<-distinct(Dev_Sum)
Dev_Sum$Treatment<-as.factor(Dev_Sum$Treatment)
levels(Dev_Sum$Treatment)
```
Compute sums remaining
```{r}
Dev_Sum$Rem<-Dev_Sum$Totalpupae-Dev_Sum$NTreat
Dev_Sum$Prop<-Dev_Sum$Rem/Dev_Sum$Totalpupae
Dev$Rem<-Dev$Npupae-Dev$CumulativeSum
Dev$Prop<-Dev$Rem/Dev$Npupae
```

```{r}
ggplot(Dev_Sum, aes(x = Hours, y = NTreat, group = interaction(Treatment,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Treatment, linetype=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("purple","red","mediumblue", "darkblue"))+
  #facet_grid(~Treatment)+
  xlab("Hours")+
  ylab("Population")+
  ggtitle("Kyn1 Experiment, w[1118]")+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(Dev_Sum, aes(x = Hours, y = NTreat, group = interaction(Treatment,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Treatment, linetype=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("purple","red","mediumblue", "darkblue"))+
  facet_grid(~Treatment)+
  xlab("Hours")+
  ylab("Population")+
  ggtitle("Kyn1 Experiment, w[1118]")
```
